blocks.text: South Korean actor Kim Soo-hyun has arrived in the Philippines ahead of his fan meet with Filipino supporters on Friday, Oct. 2. Before the scheduled event, Kim stopped by Edsa-Guadalupe and had his photos taken against the backdrop of his billboards for a popular local clothing and lifestyle brand he endorses. View this post on Instagram A post shared by BENCH/ lifestyle + clothing (@benchtm) He then attended a media conference where he expressed his gratitude to his Filipino fans for their continued support.
